currentParagraphText: “What the hell happened here?” Jake asked with confusion, Irin quickly picking up on what he was asking.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “What the hell happened here?” Jake asked with confusion, Irin quickly picking up on what he was asking.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Lady Dawnleaf, along with the Grand Elder, have made some minor modifications to give her a personal space to conduct her alchemy without disturbing you or being disturbed herself,” the succubus answered.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: However, right as they entered his residence, Jake noticed something was off. Frowning, he released a Pulse of Perception, and outside of the mansion building, things certainly didn’t look the same as usual.
